tools.name: buy_esim_plan
tools.description: Prepares the purchase of a specific eSIM plan by redirecting the user to the checkout screen of that plan (1, 3, 7, or 15 days).

days.description: The duration of the plan in days (1, 3, 7, or 15)

tools.name: check_device_compatibility
tools.description: Opens the interactive popup/modal on the screen so the user can verify if their smartphone model supports eSIM.

tools.name: list_esim_plans
tools.description: Returns the list of available eSIM plans for Andorra, including prices, duration, data allowance (GB), and descriptions in the current language.

tools.name: search_faqs
tools.description: Searches the frequently asked questions (FAQs) about Andorra eSIMs (installation, compatibility, activation, networks, etc.) and returns matches.

query.description: The search term or keyword to match in FAQ questions and answers
